runner_note: the runner acquires the canonical local-runtime lease itself, before any version probe or source snapshot, and releases it only after owned-core recovery/cleanup; do not wrap it in flock, and do not treat someone else holding the lock as ownership

local_runtime_lease.scope: shared local-runtime lease (not group-owned); held exclusively by this process for version probe -> snapshot -> run -> recovery -> cleanup
local_runtime_lease.busy_policy: bounded wait (WEBDEMO_LOCAL_RUNTIME_LEASE_TIMEOUT, default 300s) then fail closed with status=blocked and no probes executed
local_runtime_lease.inheritance: WEBDEMO_LOCAL_RUNTIME_LOCK_FD may carry an already-locked descriptor; it is adopted only if it is the same inode and excludes every other holder
